youtube.description:
Do blue-cut lenses really work? Myth vs fact.
ப்ளூ-கட் லென்ஸ் உண்மையில் வேலை செய்யுமா? உண்மை இதோ.

• Myth: screen blue light damages your eyes. Fact: there's no proof of that; the sun gives far more blue light than any phone.
• Myth: blue-cut lenses stop eye strain. Fact: strain comes from staring and blinking less; breaks and the right power help most.
• Many screen users simply find blue-cut lenses more comfortable, with less glare and reflection.
• Studies show screen use late at night can disturb sleep; put the phone away an hour before bed.
